The academy

More than
a boxing club.

Bells is a community boxing academy in the heart of Lesmahagow. Coaching comes from the very top — British, Commonwealth & 3× World Champion Andy Bell, alongside 5× Scottish Champion Wallace Frame — but the mission is bigger than boxing.

Here you build discipline, confidence and character — not just a punch. Newcomers are always welcome, learning the fundamentals in a safe, positive, champion-led gym where commitment and respect come first.

The pathway

A real route
to competition.

Bells is reaffiliated with Grassroots Boxing Alliance Scotland, giving every member a recognised route from their first session to competition.

  • Learn the fundamentals with champion coaches
  • Build fitness, discipline and confidence week by week
  • Step up to competitive boxing on a recognised pathway
  • Train in an award-winning academy — Scotland’s Boxing School of the Year
